mentions.name: 22-Service Rust E-commerce Platform
mentions.description: A distributed e-commerce platform built in Rust as 22 microservices communicating via gRPC in an event-driven architecture, using Axum and Tokio. Built to test whether Rust is viable for complex, enterprise-grade backend architectures, running on roughly 300MB RAM idle, with load benchmarks still in progress and final bugs being fixed before a demo launch.
mentions.problem: Uncertainty over whether Rust is actually viable for complex, enterprise-grade backend architectures or is just hype.
mentions.source_excerpt: To test this, I built a full distributed e-commerce system (22 microservices, gRPC, Event-Driven) using Axum and Tokio.
